title: Skill output — complete structured result of one single-modern-slot-creator run
description: The full structured output of one skill execution: identity, research, concept selection, design documents, math model, PAR sheet, all game configs, presentation/UI/audio specifications, QA results, and the artifact manifest. Math-critical fields are strictly typed; document-like blobs are permissive objects/arrays whose canonical detailed shape lives in the dedicated per-artifact schemas. Every top-level key is required; arrays may be empty when a deliverable was disabled or a section is legitimately empty (record why in unresolvedItems).

project.description: Identity and versioning of the produced game (math-critical, strict).

gameId.description: Stable machine id of the game.

gameName.description: Public display name of the game.

status.description: Honest final status. failed-gate = a step gate failed after max attempts; evidence lives in the validation report and knownRisks.

research.description: Focused research dossier backing the design decisions.

findings.description: Research findings that shaped the design (market patterns, mechanic trends, player expectations).

sources.description: Cited sources with dates (the research gate requires at least 8).

ipRisks.description: Identified IP risks and the patterns-not-to-copy list (trademarked mechanic names, studio-specific art/naming).

jurisdictionNotes.description: Per-jurisdiction regulatory notes affecting features (autoplay, bonus buy, spin speed, RTP display).

conceptCandidates.description: Exactly three scored concept candidates (concept gate). Each carries theme, hook, rubric scores, and rationale.

selectedConcept.description: The single winning concept: theme, narrative, hook, target audience, and why it beat the other candidates.

gameDesignDocument.description: Structured game design document content (rendered to docs/game-design-document.md from templates/game-design-document.md).

mathModel.description: The math model. Math-critical headline fields are strict; the full canonical shape is math-model.schema.json.

targetRtp.description: Total target RTP fraction of the default profile.

rtpTolerance.description: Allowed absolute |simRTP - targetRtp| at release simulation size.

targetHitFrequency.description: Target fraction of rounds with any win.

contributions.description: Planned RTP contribution per win source (fractions of total bet; must sum to targetRtp ±0.0005).

jackpot.description: Fixed jackpot awards; omit when no jackpots.

xBet.description: Cap as a whole-number multiple of total bet.

terminationPolicy.description: How the round ends when the cap is reached.

parSheet.description: Measured PAR sheet data (canonical shape: par-sheet.schema.json). Values are reported exactly as simulated.

rtpContributions.description: Measured RTP split per win source, plus total.

hitFrequency.description: Measured fraction of rounds with any win.

maxWinProbability.description: Per-round probability of reaching the max-win cap.

simulationProvenance.description: Reproducibility block: versions, configHash, lockfile hash, seeds, rounds, workers, command.

symbols.description: All symbol definitions (canonical per-symbol shape: symbol.schema.json).

paytable.description: The paytable (canonical shape: paytable.schema.json). Pays are integer payX100 (x-bet hundredths).

ofAKindPays.description: Map from match length ("3".."8") to integer payX100.

^[3-8]$.description: Pay in integer hundredths of a bet.

reelSets.description: All strip-based reel sets (canonical per-set shape: reel-set.schema.json).

weightedTables.description: Weighted-table reel sets and auxiliary weight tables (cash values, multiplier draws). Empty when the game is purely strip-based.

scatterFeature.description: The three-tier scatter hierarchy definition: trigger counts per tier, counting rule, retrigger policy, and per-tier content summary.

enabled.description: Whether the scatter hierarchy is active (normally true).

tiers.description: One entry per tier in canonical order.

triggerScatters.description: Scatter count triggering this tier (5+ means "this many or more" for ultimate_feature).

features.description: All feature definitions (per-tier bonus content, respins, modifiers) with purpose, trigger, state, math link, recovery, and tests.

bonusBuys.description: Bonus-buy modes. Empty when bonus buy was not built (e.g. real-money UK targeting).

priceXBet100.description: Purchase price in integer hundredths of a bet (100x -> 10000).

rtp.description: Measured/target RTP of the mode relative to its price.

enhancedChanceModes.description: Enhanced-chance (ante bet) modes. Empty when not built.

effect.description: Precise math effect of the mode.

spinPresentation.description: Spin timing per mode (normal/quick/turbo), win-tier thresholds (small/medium/big/mega/epic/max) and celebration rules. Presentation only — never affects outcomes.

autoplay.description: Autoplay configuration: spin counts, all stop conditions (win/loss limits, single-win limit, feature stop), and jurisdiction gating.

uiSpecification.description: UI/UX specification: every screen and HUD layout for portrait/landscape/tablet/desktop/ultrawide, control component states, accessibility rules.

animationEvents.description: Animation event catalog. Each event defines duration, easing, skippable, skipTo, blocksInput, audioEvent, reducedMotion + lowPerformance variants, and recovery policy.

eventId.description: Dot-notation animation event id, e.g. anim.reel.spin_start.

assetManifest.description: Every art/audio/atlas/font asset the game references, with provenance.

assetId.description: Typed asset id, e.g. img.symbol.h1.static, audio.music.base.

path.description: Project-relative file path of the asset (when generated).

generated.description: true = file was actually produced; false = prompt-only.

artPrompts.description: Every image-generation prompt (mirrors prompts/art-prompts.json), covering every visual asset in the manifest.

audioEvents.description: Audio event catalog. Each event defines loop points, priority, ducking, and polyphony; music states cover base + all three tiers.

eventId.description: Dot-notation audio/haptic event id, e.g. music.base, sfx.reel.stop.

stateMachine.description: The game state machine over the canonical state set; server-owned round states vs client presentation states are marked.

states.description: States used by the game — a subset (usually all) of the canonical state set.

outcomeManifestSchema.description: The generated JSON Schema for server outcome manifests (round steps[], grids, wins, events) — embedded verbatim as an object.

jurisdictionPolicy.description: Per-jurisdiction feature gates (autoplay, quick/turbo, slam stop, bonus buy, enhanced chance, min round duration, RTP display) plus the most-restrictive UNKNOWN default.

simulationReports.description: One report per simulation run (per RTP profile, per tier, per bonus-buy mode), each with measured stats and the full reproducibility block.

measuredRtp.description: Measured RTP fraction of this run, reported exactly (bonus-buy runs are measured against mode price).

testResults.description: Executed test-matrix results: suite, command, pass/fail counts, honest per-item outcomes (client tests, math tests, equivalence tests, schema validation).

performanceReport.description: Measured/estimated client performance: fps per device profile, load size, memory, low-performance mode behaviour.

accessibilityReport.description: Accessibility audit: reduced-motion coverage, colour-independence, touch target sizes, flash rate, contrast ratios.

complianceReview.description: Compliance review and certification-readiness checklist. Outputs are certification-ready candidates; certification is never claimed.

artifactManifest.description: Every produced file with integrity hash and provenance.

sha256.description: Integrity hash of the file bytes.

provenance.description: How the file was produced (generator step, tool, prompt id).

knownRisks.description: Honest list of known risks and limitations (failed gates, unverified estimates, prompt-only assets, IP cautions).

unresolvedItems.description: Open items the run could not resolve (missing tools, skipped deliverables, decisions needing a human).

docBlob.description: Document-like structured blob. Shape is intentionally permissive here; the dedicated per-artifact schema (when one exists) is authoritative for the file on disk.

docItem.description: One document item: either a plain string or a structured object.

rtpFraction.description: One win source's RTP contribution as a fraction of total bet.

minorUnits.description: Monetary amount in integer minor units (e.g. cents). Never a binary float.

tierId.description: Canonical scatter feature tier id (3 / 4 / 5+ scatters).

symbolId.description: Canonical symbol id, e.g. WILD, SCATTER, H1, L3, JP_GRAND.

projectSlug.description: Kebab-case project slug used for games/<slug>/.
